title.zh: 手机版回来了：/m 子路径、155 个主题片段、手机壳判据与数据体检
title.en: The phone version returns: /m, 155 theme clips, phone-shell criteria and a data audit

highlights.zh: 导出音频时先说“正在准备乐器…”，首次反馈从 6.4 秒缩到 0.1 秒；随后仍是带预计剩余时间的百分比。
highlights.en: An audio export now says "Preparing instruments…" first: the first feedback moved from 6.4 s to 0.1 s, and the percentage with its estimate still follows.

highlights.zh: 手机版以 /m 子路径回来：手机壳 40 个文件接回，编译与全部门禁通过；退役的 /m/<module> 保持退役。
highlights.en: The phone shell is back at /m: forty ported files, the compiler and every gate green, and the retired /m/<module> route stays retired.

highlights.zh: 155 个 15–30 秒主题片段，每个都用该曲风自己的音色/采样器（无一是全合成），音频放在 Cloudflare（不入 git），清单带版本与生成时间。
highlights.en: 155 clips of 15–30 seconds, each sounding through its genre's own instruments — none all-synth — served from Cloudflare rather than git, with the list carrying its version and date.

highlights.zh: 片段生成时同时体检曲风数据：空轨、和弦单调、旋律贫乏、节奏雷同、音域越界都会写进清单条目并汇总，有问题看得见。
highlights.en: Clip generation audits the genre data too: empty lanes, monotonous chords, thin melodies, identical rhythms and out-of-range notes are written into the manifest and summarised, so a flat clip is visible.

highlights.zh: 手机壳的三组判据：皮肤清单两边单向一致、44px 触控（269 个可交互元素无一低于 44px）、七套皮肤对比度（最低 5.19:1）。
highlights.en: Three phone-shell criteria: the skin lists agree in the direction that can rot, 44 px targets (269 interactive elements, none under 44 px), and the contrast of all seven skins (lowest 5.19:1).

highlights.zh: 换音源面板可以试听：每个选项旁 44px 的 ▷，点一下听得见，并且界面会说出正在试听哪一个乐器。
highlights.en: The instrument chooser can audition: a 44 px ▷ beside each option, and the surface says which instrument is sounding.

highlights.zh: 手机播放器放预生成片段：变速即变调（像唱片一样）、一键 A/B 对比两个曲风；实测加载 16.6 秒片段、走到 4.4 秒仍在放。
highlights.en: The phone player plays the cut clips: speed changes pitch like a record, and one control compares two genres (measured: a 16.6 s clip loaded and was still playing at 4.4 s).

title.zh: MCP 更好用：轨道数据、旋律落轨、冷启动有进度
title.en: MCP gets data, a melody track, and a cold start that speaks

highlights.zh: describe_arrangement 可以要 JSON 数据，trackId 不必再从散文里找。
highlights.en: describe_arrangement can answer as data, so a client need not read a track's id out of prose.

highlights.zh: 新增 melody_to_track：生成的旋律直接落到轨道，按十六分网格，不必手工拼 startBeats。
highlights.en: melody_to_track writes a generated melody onto a track on the sixteenth grid, so nobody zips four arrays by hand.

highlights.zh: 渲染冷启动先报进度；未知参数会被点名；响度报告自称是已提交基线。
highlights.en: A render announces its cold start, a tool names the arguments it never declared, and the loudness report says it is a committed baseline.

highlights.zh: 类型选择器加宽到显示完整名称；鼓轨说明用内置套鼓；压缩器降级提示只说一次。
highlights.en: The kind chooser is wide enough to name itself, a drum track explains its built-in kit, and the compressor's fallback is said once per reason.

title.zh: 音源 chip 只显示乐器名，术语改成人话
title.en: Instrument chips name the instrument, and its terms are readable

highlights.zh: 音源 chip 只显示乐器名（去掉库前缀），表头上被截断的那一截随之消失。
highlights.en: An instrument chip now shows the instrument's own name rather than its library's, and the truncation the header suffered is gone.

highlights.zh: 把库自带的术语翻成人话：arco→Bowed、pizz→Plucked、3vel→3 layers，映射类程序标明是键位映射。
highlights.en: The library's own terms are translated: arco becomes Bowed, pizz becomes Plucked, 3vel becomes 3 layers, and map programs are labelled as keyswitch maps.

highlights.zh: 查不出含义的词（three、six、basic、looped）保持原样——名字不凭空发明意思。
highlights.en: Words whose meaning the data does not show (three, six, basic, looped) are left exactly as the library writes them.

title.zh: 标识唯一化、重复控件与皮肤统一
title.en: Unique ids, a duplicate control removed, and one surface rule

highlights.zh: 轨道表头与列表不再共用同一批测试标识（一个标识对应一个元素），并删掉新手提示里与播放重复的按钮。
highlights.en: The track header and the list no longer share test ids, one id now means one element, and the hint's duplicate play button is gone.

highlights.zh: 导出菜单改用皮肤表面色，不再写死深色；悬停底色改用可编译的类——之前那批悬停其实一直没有生效。
highlights.en: The export menu uses the skin's surface instead of a hardcoded dark colour, and the hover tint uses a class Tailwind actually generates — the earlier hover never applied.

highlights.zh: 折叠的轨道列表与空状态不再像两个标题；播放读数改用正确单复数。
highlights.en: The collapsed track list reads as a control rather than a second heading, and the transport readout uses real plurals.

highlights.zh: 修复采样音符在实时播放被硬切的问题（离线一直是对的），虚拟键盘与编排播放不再有咔声。
highlights.en: A sampled note is no longer cut at its gate on the live paths — the offline sink was always right — so the keyboard and arrangement playback stop clicking.

title.zh: 音源面板可点、chip 可读、门禁与文案修复
title.en: A clickable instrument panel, a readable chip, and gate and copy fixes

highlights.zh: 音源选择面板改为浮动层并钳制进视口，选项不再被下方详情区盖住、可以点选。
highlights.en: The instrument panel is a floating layer clamped into the viewport, so its options are no longer covered by the detail area below.

highlights.zh: 音源 chip 桌面从 112×17 变为 152×28，手机从 10px 宽变为 104px，并可看到完整乐名。
highlights.en: The instrument chip grew from 112×17 to 152×28 on desktop and from 10px wide to 104px on a phone, with the full name on hover.

highlights.zh: 工具栏按钮有了悬停反馈；轨道 chip 的测试标识不再重复；播放提示改用正确单复数。
highlights.en: Toolbar buttons respond to hover, a track's chip no longer shares its test id with the header's copy, and the transport readout uses real plurals.

highlights.zh: 首次进入的音频门禁可点背景关闭，不再挡住新建工程的按钮；量化一词改用美式拼写。
highlights.en: The first-run audio gate closes when its backdrop is clicked, so it stops covering the Create button, and the quantize label is spelled the US way.

title.zh: 修复新建工程页点击无反应
title.en: Fixes the new-project page whose Create button did nothing

highlights.zh: 新建工程页点击“创建”没有反应：新手引导的遮罩盖在页面上，把点击吃掉了。
highlights.en: On the new-project page, pressing Create did nothing: the first-run tour's overlay covered the page and swallowed the click.

highlights.zh: 引导不再在新建工程页自动弹出，仍可从帮助里随时打开，其它页面行为不变。
highlights.en: The tour no longer opens itself on the new-project route; it is still available from Help, and other routes behave as before.

title.zh: 小屏触控与音源面板可读性修复
title.en: Touch targets on phones, and a readable instrument chooser

highlights.zh: 手机上的静音、独奏、删除与加轨等控件改为 44px 命中区，且不改变轨道行高。
highlights.en: Mute, solo, remove and add-track controls now offer a 44px hit area on phones without changing the track row height.

highlights.zh: 换音源面板补上不透明表面，分类与乐器行不再压在编排画布的文字上。
highlights.en: The instrument chooser declares its own surface, so its categories and rows no longer overlap the arrangement behind them.

highlights.zh: 修复轨道行高取值缺失时的回退，避免个别浏览器下头列与数据列错位。
highlights.en: A missing track-height variable now falls back to its design value, so the header and lane columns cannot drift apart.

highlights.zh: 修正 MCP 构建版本检查的假报警；编排播放探针改为断言播放越过循环。
highlights.en: The MCP build check no longer reports a false version mismatch, and the arrangement-playback probe asserts playing past the loop.

title.zh: 分析快 28 倍、MusicXML 多谱表、可用性修复
title.en: Analysis 28× faster, multi-part MusicXML, and usability fixes

highlights.zh: 五分钟音频首次分析从 287 秒降到 10.2 秒；新增"只看响度与频谱"的轻量模式。
highlights.en: A first five-minute analysis went from 287s to 10.2s, and a loudness-and-spectrum-only mode was added.

highlights.zh: MusicXML 可每个声部一个谱表；工程名随包传递，导出默认以标题命名。
highlights.en: MusicXML can export one part per lane; a project's name travels in its package and names the export.

highlights.zh: 空查询不再崩溃、未知轨道被拒绝、单边范围与时长预算如实报告、低音区音符在卷帘可见。
highlights.en: An empty search no longer crashes, unknown tracks are refused, one-sided spans and the duration budget report what they did, and bass notes are visible in the roll.

highlights.zh: 回包标明分析是否来自缓存；渲染说明 MP3 编码阶段；乐器列表给出实测音域与安全时长。
highlights.en: Replies say whether an analysis came from cache, a render announces its MP3 encode stage, and the instrument list gives the measured compass and safe duration.

title.zh: 编辑更快更省：音符应答改增量、卷帘只画可见格、六处可读性修复
title.en: Editing that is faster and lighter: delta note replies, a roll that draws only what is visible, and six readability fixes

highlights.zh: 改一个音符的回包不再带整首曲子：+4.9 KB/批 → +1 字节，`verbose: true` 可取回全量。
highlights.en: A note edit no longer returns the whole arrangement: +4.9 KB per batch became +1 byte, and `verbose: true` restores the old reply.

highlights.zh: 卷帘 126 小节从 74,592 个格子降到 2,368，且不再随曲长增长。
highlights.en: The roll's 126 bars went from 74,592 cells to 2,368, and the count no longer follows the length of the piece.

highlights.zh: 六处对比度修复改用各皮肤自己的墨色；pixel 皮肤不再吃微格热区、不再要半像素字号。
highlights.en: Six contrast fixes take each skin's own ink; the pixel skin no longer eats micro-cell hit areas or asks for half-pixel sizes.

highlights.zh: 乐器列表给出实测音域；力度在卷帘内可改；空查询不再崩溃。
highlights.en: The instrument list states the measured compass; a note's velocity is visible and editable inside the roll; an empty search no longer crashes.

title.zh: 长曲子渲染默认分块（快 2.5 倍）、单音符力度可看可改、导出报进度与剩余时间
title.en: Long renders 2.5× faster, a note's velocity you can see and change, and an export that says how much longer

highlights.zh: 五分钟渲染 753 秒 → 297 秒：长曲子默认多段多进程；等价性由逐样本判据守住。`chunks: 1` 可关。
highlights.en: A five-minute render went 753 s → 297 s: long pieces are chunked across processes by default, with sample-accurate equivalence held by a criterion; `chunks: 1` turns it off.

highlights.zh: 单个音符的力度现在看得到也改得了：音符带着力度，框选后用工具条调整，每音符一步撤销。
highlights.en: A note's velocity is visible and editable: notes carry their own value, and a selection can be re-voiced from the toolbar, one undo step per note.

highlights.zh: 导出的母带报进度与剩余时间，数字来自渲染器自己的每 10% 回调。
highlights.en: A master export reports progress and time left, from the renderer's own ten-percent callbacks.

highlights.zh: 导入的编曲与文件同长，并采用文件自己的速度与拍号。
highlights.en: An imported arrangement is as long as its file and takes the file's own tempo and meter.
